sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:150370-DB Court No. - 29 Case :- WRIT - C No. - 30747 of 2024 Petitioner :- Punit Kumar Agarwal And 3 Others Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Rahul Pandey,Rang Nath Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Pankaj Srivastava Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State respondents, Shri Dharmendra Srivastava, learned counsel for respondent no.3 and Shri Pankaj Srivastava, learned counsel for Nagar Nigam, Meerut.
2. Present writ petition is preferred inter-alia with following reliefs:-
Punit Kumar Agarwal And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58596995/
1

"(i) A writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing respondents concerned to Award/Disburse/Pay the compensation to the petitioners in lieu of acquired land Khasra No.1965 measuring 179.11 Sq. Mtrs. situated at Meerut Khas (Delhi Road), District Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, which has been acquired by the Government for Rapid Rail Project, as per admissibility.
(ii) A writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondent no.2 to decide the Objections dated 23.06.2023 and 15.07.2024 submitted by petitioners.
(iii) A writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondent concerned not to Award/Disburse/Pay the compensation to any one else in lieu of acquired land of the petitioners being Khasra No.1965 measuring 179.11 Sq. Mtrs. situated at Meerut Khas (Delhi Road), District Meerut, Uttar Pradesh,
which has been acquired by the Government for Rapid Rail Project."
3.

At the very outset, Shri Pankaj Srivastava, learned counsel for Nagar Nigam raised preliminary objection qua maintainability of the writ petition on the ground that first appeal and other litigation are pending consideration before this Court as well as District Judiciary and also placed reliance on the Notification no.1985 dated 27.04.2023 under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, wherein, the land is recorded as 'Banjar' and Nagar Nigam is custodian of the land and as such, the writ petition is not maintainable at the behest of petitioners.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. It is apprised that against the said notification, petitioners have moved objections on 23.06.2023 and 15.07.2024 before the Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition)-respondent no.2,
which are still pending consideration.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, once the proceeding is on pursuant to the Notification dated 27.04.2023 and petitioner has filed his objection in the same, we are not inclined to keep the matter pending consideration.

The writ petition is disposed of with an observation that the objections of the petitioners may be decided by the Competent Authority expeditiously and while deciding the same, the version of Nagar Nigam may also be heard.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 A. Pandey  Punit Kumar Agarwal And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58596995/
